component.name: Waves
component.summary: Save music from your own TIDAL account for offline listening

description.p: Waves is a native desktop app for saving music from your own TIDAL account for offline listening: search-first, art-forward, and built for people who'd rather click than type. It can only save what your account can already play, up to HiRes Lossless and Dolby Atmos where available.
